parameters.name: EnablePage
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable pagination query.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance that you want to query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.
